answer: Someone running 107 aliases thus needs 133 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in opal, expire in horizon, and quill lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3792 identities would post 4517 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
